Here is a small thing that changes conversations, and it costs nothing. Most of us open with what do you do, and the honest problem with that question is that it gets you a job title, and a job title is not a person. Try a different one. Have you ever, and then anything at all. Have you ever lived in another country. Have you ever worked at night. Have you ever met somebody famous. It asks about a whole life without asking for a single date, so nobody has to remember anything, and there is no wrong answer. And here is the part that surprises people. Almost everybody asks it back. You ask one question, and the conversation keeps going on its own for twenty minutes.

I put this trip off for about twenty years. Every single year there was a reason, and every reason was a good one at the time. Work, money, children, the wrong month. Then last year I stopped explaining it to myself and I booked the flight. The first two days were fine and nothing special. The highlight was the second afternoon, when I got lost looking for a museum and I found a street market instead. I stayed there until it closed. I have travelled a reasonable amount since then, and I have noticed something. I have never regretted going anywhere. I have regretted waiting, every single time.
